chunk_title: Training Intensity and Zones for Beginners
content: Training intensity for 10K beginners is commonly prescribed using heart rate zones or perceived exertion scales. Low to moderate intensities (Zone 1-2, about 50-75% of maximum heart rate) form the foundation, promoting aerobic base building without excessive fatigue. Higher intensities (Zone 3, near lactate threshold) are introduced gradually for improved speed and endurance. Understanding and monitoring these intensity zones reduces the risk of overtraining while optimizing training benefits.

Scheduled cutback or recovery weeks every 3-4 weeks reduce cumulative fatigue.
